mechanism: Both drugs reduce glomerular filtration rate and increase serum potassium; captopril inhibits ACE-mediated aldosterone suppression while tacrolimus causes renal vasoconstriction and potassium retention, creating synergistic hyperkalemia and renal dysfunction risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative antihypertensive; maintain adequate hydration and avoid NSAIDs concurrently.
